subject: Quick note on Barum & Dewar's website
bodyText:
Hi,

I'm Mani from Rogue.

We look for solid businesses that still look stuck online - and Barum & Dewar stood out.

Barnstaple packaging specialists on the Two Rivers Industrial Estate - and barumanddewar.com still loads jquery-1.8.3.min.js plus html5shiv.js and respond.min.js, while the contact page still invites people to Send us a fax on +44 (0)1271 344870. Serious defence and industrial packaging capacity; a front end still wired for IE8-era tooling.
